resources.name: Elk all-electron full-potential linearised augmented-plane-wave (FP-LAPW) code

access.notes: Open-source; version 6.0 or later uses LDA+SOC.
Lattice parameters a=14.17 Å, b=4.535 Å, c=10.87 Å, β=92.0° and atomic positions (Sn(2a), Sn(4i), I(4ia), I(4ib), I(4ic)) as given in the instruction.
